novel_mechanics_found: LEVEL 5: the four previously unexplained AA99 quadrants are directional controls for a movable color-8 structure: (44,29)=left, (49,29)=up, (54,29)=right, and (59,29)=down, moving in four-pixel increments. The structure must first be routed upward at the far-left side, moved right until it touches the color-12 slab, and latched with the 8 button at (52,35); direction clicks then drag the combined 8/12 structure. Routing that combined structure left, down, then right makes a temporary bridge between the disconnected start and upper platforms. The large 6 button at (52,48), an unexplained control missed by the earlier shallow scout, teleports the avatar between the checker portals. The 9 button transfers solidity between the west and east 9 regions and refuses if the avatar would lose support. The 2 button opens the row-44 wall from both ends, briefly yields a full color-12 bridge, then closes it from the middle outward; the B button shifts the row-54 shelf right and wraps.
narrative: Resolved the 212-action banked prefix and replayed it from two fresh environments, both times confirming frame.levels_completed == 4. On level 5 I independently grounded the hidden four-direction controls, latched and routed the movable 8/12 bridge, crossed into the upper region, restored the bridge, reached the top checker, and used the hidden 6 control to teleport to the lower-west stack. I opened and crossed the row-44 bridge, positioned the lower shelf under the dotted color-15 chute, and tested the visible controls and all 6/9 phase combinations; the chute remained non-walkable. Advancing the 2-button cycle after crossing closed the bridge from the center and irreversibly trapped the avatar at its east endpoint, where the final closure is refused because it would delete the avatar's support. No level-5 win was observed. I stopped at 593 total env.step calls because the remaining 107 calls could not fund the 212-action replay needed for a new live attempt or reproduction gate.
gotchas: Direction mapping remains ACTION1=up, ACTION2=down, ACTION3=left, ACTION4=right; movement is two pixels.
The 8 piece is initially independent. The 8 button only produced a visible latch/change after the piece was aligned with the 12 slab; afterward the direction controls dragged both together.
The 9 button is refused if transferring solidity would remove the player's current support.

The 2-button bridge is stateful: after becoming a complete color-12 bridge, further clicks close it from the center. Standing at the far-right endpoint can trap the player because the last closure is refused while they remain there.
The B shelf wraps from its rightmost position back to the left; move it to x=24..29 before attempting the lower color-15 descent.
The banked 212-label prefix reached level 4 in both fresh environments used this session; no new level-5 sequence was completed.

For the next attempt, finish probing the 2-button material cycle while the avatar is still on the fixed west pad before crossing the row-44 bridge; crossing at the full-open stage and then advancing the cycle creates an irreversible east-end trap.
Blocked/no-op actions still consume the game's visible tick counter and the campaign env.step budget.
